bio: At 1718, elegant period architectural elements blend beautifully with modern design. Part of Ketschauer Hof hotel, the restaurant sits across from the fine dining restaurant L.A. Jordan – separating them is a lovely terrace in the peaceful, verdant courtyard. On the menu, French and international cuisine are the order of the day, accompanied by a superb selection of wines from the Palatinate and beyond. Tip: The establishment runs a wine shop around the corner....
